scope: Every current Android Extras option is listed in feature-attestation.json. Only the explicit entries below record this cross-source review; source references alone never count as completed behavior review.

findings: Resolve explicit local attachments before the owning account's cache.
Preflight missing media before the first upload; preserve 64-bit document sizes and independent attribute lists.
Stop waits on transfer failures/interruption/timeouts and release all subscriptions.
Snapshot UI selection before a worker reads it; distinguish private dialog IDs from chat IDs.
Predecode every photo before any upload; a corrupt second photo must not leave an incomplete album.
Track exact IDs at creation, including scheduled sends, and wait for every album item's server completion. An unrelated send or transport ACK cannot advance the batch.
remaining: Authenticated server acceptance, album delivery/order, scheduled sends and retry behavior are not certified.
Unsupported media now fails explicitly. Reply mapping and protected non-media types are not declared full parity.

findings: Boolean switch and string entries shared one preference key, causing ClassCastException; split keys and migrate legacy entries.
Existing Extras now includes the list, jump and removal, with malformed-record checks and 64-bit/private/secret navigation arguments. Native dialogs were exercised in EN/RU UI tests.
Secret messages use negative local IDs: retain them while rejecting unsent negative cloud IDs and invalid encrypted-chat IDs. Logout clears current and legacy bookmark data before account-slot reuse.
remaining: iOS tags and stored snippets are not ported. Real jump-to-message still requires an authenticated account.

findings: Replace string prefix concatenation with the numeric channel offset, including short, long and monoforum IDs.

The account's switch wrote AyuGram's global flag, and a global OR prevented disabling ads for one account. Stop global writes, honor the per-account value in both directions and use the legacy global preference only as an unset slot's initial value.
Extras now updates only the account's option and FilterStore; it no longer switches the separate process-wide legacy Ayu filter on other accounts.
Extras must not overwrite the process-wide legacy Ayu filter's case policy when one account changes its own matching option.

Tag automatically scheduled local messages, refresh only their request dates after slow upload and preserve manually chosen dates. Track their exact completion rather than polling an ordinary-send map.
remaining: Actual scheduled delivery, Ghost receipts and delayed paid-send interactions require a test account.

findings: Automatic preview no longer overwrites forceShowPollResults or blocks voting. Hidden-until-close polls retain their restriction; disabling the option removes only automatic preview.

Previously it dropped reaction notifications and claimed to strip outgoing mentions. It now suppresses group personal-notification overrides, mention badges and mention exceptions in muted/read folders, preserving private routing and server counts.

AudioSource.MIC alone did not select a physical microphone and recorder V2 ignored the preference. Both voice recorders and round video now use the owning account's selected built-in input, validate routing and avoid starting Bluetooth SCO for it.
Failed legacy resumes now release the recorder and preserve the prior draft segment.
remaining: Physical Bluetooth route changes need acceptance. This option does not change VoIP call routing.

findings: Gate the actual managing-business-bot panel; the old hook incorrectly hid bot verification information.
Allowing screenshots removed FLAG_SECURE but still created an outgoing screenshot notification. The secret-chat sending boundary now honors the same per-account policy, including retries.

The old option only disabled a server filter; it never retained vanished gifts. Opt-in private snapshots now retain up to 200 historical gifts per profile, 1000 current gifts, 20 profiles and 2 MiB per file. Only complete unfiltered lists are reconciled; duplicates/short pages cannot infer disappearance. Reappearing/upgraded gifts are reconciled; logout clears storage.
The profile grid separates historical snapshots and blocks ownership actions on them.
remaining: Server pagination, real profile rendering and transfers need account acceptance. Evicted or never-observed gifts cannot be reconstructed.

findings: Photo-viewer return requires backdrop recapture; the earlier main commit adds it. Compose switch-lens changes do not directly apply to this native renderer.
remaining: Exact keyboard flicker from the recording and 120/60/30 Hz behavior require physical-device reproduction and measurements.

cross_cutting.finding: Captured PCM accumulated without a bound while the encoder queue was blocked. Bound it to 500 20-ms chunks, stop capture with an explicit error, and handle allocation failures rather than dropping audio or growing until OOM.

release_gate: Complete remaining semantic comparisons instead of treating all 157 wired switches as accepted features.
Pass CI for the exact release commit; local results cannot stand in for the API 33–36 matrix after these changes.
Reproduce the recorded keyboard/refresh-rate issue on a physical device and validate Bluetooth input routing.
Ghost, Telegram edits/deletes, story receipts, session restoration and sending still lack authenticated acceptance; the user has no test account.
